title: selaginella leveillei
intro: Selaginella leveillei, commonly known as the "spikemoss" or "resurrection plant," is a type of evergreen, terrestrial plant belonging to the Selaginellaceae family. It is prized for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, making it a useful natural remedy for various ailments. The therapeutic actions of Selaginella leveillei are attributed to its ability to regulate blood sugar levels, lower blood pressure, and exhibit anti-cancer properties. The plant's bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, have been identified as responsible for its medicinal properties.
